University credit is awarded for work in an exchange program; it may be counted as coursework taken in residence. Transfer credit is awarded for work in an affiliated studies program. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Topics in Malayalam Language and Literature
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Modern Malayalam Drama
courses.description: Focus on 20th-century drama and plays in Malayalam. Examine both the text of the play and its status as socially relevant art, to develop an overview of theatre movements in Malayalam literature and Kerala society. Engage through speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Malayalam 330 (Topic: Contemp Malayalam Drama) and 330E may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Short Novels of Basheer
courses.description: Read and discuss two short novels by Vaikkom Muhammad Basheer, celebrated author and activist for Indian independence. Engage through speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Malayalam 330 (Topic: Short Novels of Basheer) and 330F may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Contemporary Malayalam Short Stories
courses.description: Focus on reading short story collections from mainstream and women writers from modern Malayalam literature dealing with social, political, and economic life context. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Malayalam Cinema and Screenplays
courses.description: Focus on reading Malayalam screenplays to improve speaking and listening proficiency in conversational and colloquial Malayalam. Acquire a general knowledge of proverbs and sayings which are very commonly use in Malayali social life. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Malayalam 330 (Topic: Malayalam Cinema/Screenplay) and 330J may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Stories from Aithihyamaala
courses.description: Explore selected stories from Aithihyamala (Garland of Legends) written by Kottarathil Sankunni. Examine the history behind the famous persons and events in Kerala, including feudal rulers, Kalaripayattu martial art and Ayurveda in Kerala. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Reform Movements in Kerala
courses.description: Focus on the foundations of social changes in Kerala in the nineteenth to twentieth centuries. Explore selected Malayalam articles related to Kerala history to acquire a general knowledge of prominent leaders of Kerala reformation and a brief history of revolts and movements in Kerala. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Conference Course in Malayalam Language and Literature
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Malayalam language or literature. Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Malayalam 312L and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.
courses.prereqText: Malayalam 312L and written consent of instructor on form obtained from the undergraduate adviser.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Conference Course in Malayalam Language and Culture
courses.description: Supervised individual study in Malayalam language or culture. The equivalent of three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and written consent of instructor on a form obtained from the graduate coordinator.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and written consent of instructor on a form obtained from the graduate coordinator.

courses.subject: MAL
courses.title: Topics in Malayalam Language and Culture
courses.description: Study of various aspects and periods of Malayalam language and culture. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Malayalam or consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Malayalam or consent of instructor.
